name: Asian Paints Limited
remarksWeb: 1. Five individuals viz. Mr. Anay Rupen Choksi, Ms. Nysha Rupen Choksi, Ms. Ishwara Hasit Dani, Mr. Hrishav Varun Vakil and Ms. Nyra Varun Vakil, being part of Promoter(s) & Promoter(s) Group of the Company and acting together are SBOs based on the disclosures received from them and in terms of the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018. However, they have not been considered as SBOs for the purpose of disclosure in eForm BEN 2 as they are minors and the form does not allow inclusion of their names. Accordingly, in the same lines they have even not been included here. 2. During submission of the shareholding pattern for the quarter ended 30th June, 2023, the Company had removed following trust(s) from the Promoter(s) & Promoter(s) Group based on the letter received from one of the Promoter(s) of the Company:  a) Advaita Charitable Trust, Sab Ka Mangal Ho Foundation, Dani Charitable Foundation, Homevilla Charitable Trust and ASHWIN-INA Charitable Trust have been removed from the list of Promoter(s) Group of the Company. The said trust(s) were not holding any shares of the Company. Now basis the clarification received by the Company from NSE through their email dated 19th October, 2023, the said trust(s) have been reinstated as part of the Promoter(s) Group.
